# glinet_system_timezone (Resource)

Manages the time zone of the router. The router has one time zone configuration, so use one instance of this resource. Destroy removes the resource from the Terraform state and does not change the router. This resource does not change the router clock.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_system_timezone" "this" {
  zonename = "America/New York"
  timezone = "EST5EDT,M3.2.0,M11.1.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `timezone` (String) POSIX TZ string, for example `EST5EDT,M3.2.0,M11.1.0`.
- `zonename` (String) Time zone name as the router shows it, for example `America/New York`.

### Read-Only

- `auto_timezone_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the router sets the time zone automatically. The router does not let this resource change it.
- `id` (String) Always `timezone`.
- `tzoffset` (String) Current offset from UTC, for example `-0500`. It changes with daylight saving time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "timezone".
terraform import glinet_system_timezone.this timezone
```
